title: The Ultimate Local Marketing Guide for Australian Businesses

facts.fact: According to the Australian Small Business and Family Enterprise Ombudsman, small businesses account for nearly 98% of all businesses in Australia.
facts.quote: small businesses account for nearly 98% of all businesses in Australia.

facts.fact: According to Social Media News (February 2023 statistics), Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn are among the most used social media platforms in Australia.
facts.quote: Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn are among the most used platforms in Australia.

facts.fact: The guide was published on 23 July 2024.
The guide advises that sidewalk signage should be eye-catching and comply with local council regulations.
facts.quote: Ensure your signage is eye-catching and complies with local council regulations.

facts.fact: Zambrero's hyperlocal digital ads for a new Newtown, Sydney store targeted users within a 1.5 km radius of the location.
facts.quote: they created ads specifically targeting users within a 1.5 km radius of the location.

facts.fact: According to the page, Zambrero's hyperlocal ad approach resulted in a 23% increase in foot traffic during the first week of opening compared to its standard location-based ads.
facts.quote: This hyperlocal approach resulted in a 23% increase in foot traffic during the first week of opening compared to their standard location-based ads.

facts.fact: The page cites a Bain & Company study claiming that increasing customer retention rates by just 5% can increase profits by 25% to 95%.
facts.quote: increasing customer retention rates by just 5% can increase profits by 25% to 95%.

facts.fact: Campos Coffee's Coffee Club awards members 1 point for every $1 spent in its Flagship Cafes and Online Store, according to the Campos website as quoted on the page.
facts.quote: As a member of our Coffee Club, you’ll earn 1 point for every $1 you spend in our Flagship Cafes and Online Store.

facts.fact: Vinomofo's wine club lets customers choose delivery frequency of monthly, bi-monthly, or quarterly and a quantity of 6 or 12 bottles.
facts.quote: Customers can personalise delivery frequency (monthly, bi-monthly, quarterly) and quantity (6 or 12 bottles).

facts.fact: T2's Tea Society loyalty program includes a free birthday brew as a member benefit, per the T2 website as cited on the page.
Harris Farm Markets' 'Imperfect Picks' campaign reportedly reduced food waste by up to 50% in some of its stores, as stated by the page.
facts.unit: % reduction in food waste (up to, some stores)
facts.quote: Reduced food waste by up to 50% in some of their stores

facts.fact: Bakers Delight donates 100% of Fun Bun sales to the Breast Cancer Network Australia as part of its annual Pink Bun campaign, according to the page.
facts.quote: Donate 100% of Fun Bun sales and collect customer donations

facts.fact: Bakers Delight states on its community engagement page that it has raised over $24 million for BCNA since 2000 (currency not specified on the page).
facts.quote: Raised over $24 million for BCNA since 2000

facts.fact: Bakers Delight states that it has supported hundreds of local sporting clubs across Australia.
facts.quote: Supported hundreds of local sporting clubs across Australia

facts.fact: Gelato Messina's limited-edition 'Oh Snap!' flavour was available for free on Mates Day, a campaign launched in partnership with Snapchat.
facts.quote: Created the limited-edition flavor “Oh Snap!” available for free on Mates Day.
